propositions: Multiple S3 bundles for a single ref cause clone/push failures and trigger data loss when git-remote-s3's interactive Doctor discards non-chosen heads instead of merging them.
Rebar's existing _union_merge reconciliation logic (lossless 2-parent merge with merge=ours for .bridge_state) must be reused via iterated merges in s3_doctor to avoid losing divergent events.
The heal must acquire git-remote-s3's per-ref S3 lock (conditional-put with TTL/steal), re-enumerate bundles under lock to guard TOCTOU, then fold all heads into a merged tip before any deletion.
The merged bundle must be written as a new object via S3Remote.s3.put_object before any original bundle is deleted, ensuring ≥1 lossless bundle survives every crash point.

Push must detect multi-bundle signatures (_is_multi_bundle), invoke the heal exactly once per push (healed_once guard), and retry; shared-remote semantics mean backing-off processes converge on the winner's collapsed state.

Non-derived-file merge conflicts must abort without deleting any remote bundle, surface fsck-recover, and never discard a parent; all S3 access routes through git-remote-s3's own S3Remote/.s3 with boto3 transitively optional.
